name: payments
summary: Charging an app's own customers from inside the constrained app model: Stripe request builders over the header-carrying egress call, a `t=,v1=` webhook verifier that MACs the raw request bytes, the idempotent event-admission ledger a guarded commit carries, a fixed-backoff dunning schedule, and the x402 header path (challenge, settle, replay-ledger) for machine payments. Every digest and MAC comes from `ferrite_app::crypto`; the kit vendors no crypto of its own.
